For this session, as planning/mvp-m5-plan.md decides (decision 2), the console tool typed at U-Boot through that window: 74 sends making 73 lines, each echo-compared before its Enter, and 91 keystrokes in all, each logged with its time and log offset in the session's `keys.log`; the responsible human did not type during the session, confirmed the board free and the recorded `bootcmd` (`K3_ENV_CONFIRM`, the first 12 hexadecimal digits of its SHA-256, equal to release candidate 2's) before the session, and was present at the install and the restore. The segment of this campaign, `20261031-com260-rc3`, begins at log line 155,022 (04:14 UTC) with Fedora's clean shutdown over SSH (`systemctl reboot`, which halts this board at `reboot: Restarting system`) after the preflight (04:12 UTC) and the staging of the fourteen images on the `beryllium` partition, and runs to the end of the log as read (line 164,840, Fedora's login prompt after the restore, 04:37 UTC). It holds 39 `k3ctl` resets (`reset_reply=OK` each time; the first on Fedora down, 18 at an idle U-Boot prompt after a completed command, 20 after a run's terminal marker and its tail wait) and 39 boots, one per reset and none unexplained: the boot ROM's terse lines (`try sd...`, `ERROR: CMD8`), `U-Boot SPL 2022.10 (May 21 2026 - 07:43:32 +0000)` with its DDR line, `U-Boot 2022.10 (May 21 2026 - 07:43:32 +0000), Build: jenkins-BSP-build-bsp-deb-395` with its device probes, `WDT: Started watchdog@d4014000 with servicing (60s timeout)`, the `227 bytes read` of `env_k3.txt`, and `Autoboot in 3 seconds`. Twenty boots were the counted runs, each launched by its own reset with Fedora down, the saved `bootcmd` running `be_boot`: `nvme scan`, `2584576 bytes read in 2 ms`, `md5 for 140000000 ... 140276fff ==> <the staged image's MD5>`, `Moving Image from 0x140000000 to 0x108000000, end=108277000`, `## Flattened Device Tree blob at 2fbe8aa50`, `Loading Device Tree to 00000002fbd5d000, end 00000002fbd6f2ef ...
